The main takeaway from our work is that
the yellow head-like virus that is associated with the disease, 'periphery neuropathy and retinitis' (PNR), can be found in the eyes and peripheral nerves.
yellow head-related viruses, which have been reported in many penaeid shrimp species, can cause fatal disease in P. monodon.
